name: io.github.atzzCokeK/kintai-plus-mcp
title: Kintai Plus (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for Money Forward Cloud Kintai Plus (AKASHI): punches, records, man-hours

environmentVariables.name: KINTAI_PLUS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token (only for first-time import; `npx kintai-plus-mcp login` is recommended instead)

environmentVariables.name: KINTAI_PLUS_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Login company ID (ログイン企業ID), used with KINTAI_PLUS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: KINTAI_PLUS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: API host (the domain of the URL after you sign in)

environmentVariables.name: CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Ask for confirmation (elicitation) before punches and man-hour changes
